history.title: Reconciled capacity, compensation and annual prepayment
history.summary: Restored six owner routine visits with a separate urgent reserve; aligned coverage-inclusive expenses, compensation and surplus across the page and PDF; separated physical utilization, bookable capacity, upfront cash and earned revenue; preserved earlier worksheets and the optional junior scenario.
